title: The Silent Spire
author: Emrys Nystrom
blurb: Orsen Nystrom, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
